name: Toma Snana
notes: He remembers procedures; she remembers what was removed.

name: Nara Snana
notes: Nara has asked her whether the oldest chants ever existed in plain, unceremonial form.

name: Sena Sabha
notes: Both understand memory instability from different angles; Sena considers her the most reliable historical source in town.

name: Ikan Sabha
notes: She does not discourage his curiosity, nor guide it directly.

name: Tarek Sabha
notes: Interaction records removed; she is privately aware he still watches outcomes of decisions she once influenced.

name: Luma Sabha
notes: Aware Luma checks on her from a distance without ever announcing it.

name: Ren Mudra
notes: Both reconstruct lost systems from fragments, using different methods.

name: Kalen Mudra
notes: She trusts his structural interpretations more than most others' theories.

name: Fen Bhata
notes: Unsurprised when he described what he found in the Old Canal Bed.

name: Mara Kothar
notes: Shared what pre-Turning granary records she retained when asked.

name: Doran Kothar
notes: Shared old terrace maps with her; suspects she already knew what they'd show.

name: Ena Vrisha
notes: The only official-adjacent figure who treated Ena's illness maps as serious evidence.

name: Roka Vrisha
notes: Confirmed for him how much old grazing land is now salt-crusted.

name: Bran Bhata
notes: Gave her old wood-count tallies; troubled by the gaps she found in the official record.

name: Yara Bhata
notes: Answered her questions about pre-Turning kiln counts truthfully.
